question_text: Did people who came through the main entrance also show up at the keynote? How many people were tracked at both locations compared to just the main entrance?
answer_text: No people who came through the main entrance were tracked at both the main entrance and the keynote location. There were 1,904 people tracked only at the main entrance.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e1:Event {event_type: 'person_entry'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c1:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l1:Location)
  WHERE l1.name CONTAINS 'MainEntrance' AND e1.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e1.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN e1.object_id AS person_id
  UNION
  MATCH (e2:Event {event_type: 'person_entry'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c2:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l2:Location)
  WHERE l2.name CONTAINS 'Keynote' AND e2.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e2.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN e2.object_id AS person_id
}
WITH person_id, count(person_id) AS appearances
RETURN 
  sum(CASE WHEN appearances = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_locations,
  sum(CASE WHEN appearances = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS main_entrance_only
